The '''Governor's palace''' was located in [[Pixelito/Legends|Pixelito]], the capital city of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. It was the main government building and residence of the planet's [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] it was the residence of Governor [[Gujdim Wiphshun]] and hosted the peace talks between the [[House of Lannik]] and the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group.
